description: COVID-EMDA+ (Coronavirus Disease - Electricity Market Data Aggregation+) is a dataset listed in Open Energy Hub (ORNL), an energy-sector data hub, published or maintained by Oak Ridge National Laboratory for the U.S. DOE Office of Electricity. This data hub, COVID-EMDA+ (Coronavirus Disease - Electricity Market Data Aggregation+), is specifically designed to track the potential impacts of COVID-19 on the existing U.S. electricity markets. Many different data sources are merged and harmonized here in order to enable further interdisciplinary researches. ( Publication: This data hub contains five major components: U.S. Coverage: the United States. The portal files it under Electricity, Health. Its keywords are electricity markets, covid impact. The portal shows 2024-08-13 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is MIT License (https://opensource.org/license/mit). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oeh-open-data-portal.
